priorities.heading: Defending the 2nd Amendment
priorities.quote: Lydia will unchain Michiganders’ constitutional right to bear arms by defending the 2nd Amendment.

priorities.heading: Repealing the Patriot Act: Defending Civil Liberties
priorities.quote: Lydia will push to end sneak-and-peek delayed notice outside genuine emergencies and require judicial approval before a National Security Letter can compel anyone's records.

priorities.heading: Fighting Mass Surveillance and Technofeudalism: A Bill of Digital Rights
priorities.quote: Lydia will fight warrantless surveillance of Americans' communications, dismantle the license plate reader dragnet, and introduce a Bill of Digital Rights making your data your property.

cost-of-living.heading: Real Tax Relief: No Income Tax Under $150,000
cost-of-living.quote: No federal income tax on any earnings under $150,000 a year, a real step toward eliminating the federal income tax entirely, and an end to the hidden tax of private insurance premiums, deductibles, and surprise bills eating into paychecks before workers ever see them.

housing.heading: Solving Michigan's Housing Crisis
housing.quote: Lydia will pass a rapid rehousing program through HHS to get Michiganders off the streets fast, funded by capping the Pentagon budget rather than cutting help for people.

health-care.heading: Medicaid for All: Real Choice, Real Coverage
health-care.quote: Medicaid for All is opt-in coverage for citizens and legal residents. All medically necessary care is covered, no diagnosis or category required.

immigration.heading: Protecting Dreamers and DACA
immigration.quote: Lydia will push for a permanent solution for Dreamers, protecting them from deportation, offering them a pathway to citizenship, and ensuring their futures in the United States.

foreign-policy.heading: Ending the War in Iran
foreign-policy.quote: Lydia will vote for binding legislation, oppose further war funding without authorization, and close the ceasefire loophole the administration is using to sidestep the law.

climate-energy.heading: Ending Fossil Fuel Subsidies
climate-energy.quote: Lydia supports ending these industry-specific tax carve-outs and redirecting the money toward Michigan families instead of shareholders.

priorities.heading: Money Out of Politics
priorities.quote: To get corporate and special interest money out of politics, I support legislation to overturn the disastrous Citizens United Supreme Court decision.

priorities.heading: Money in Your Pocket
priorities.quote: I believe in bringing dignified, well-paying jobs to Michigan. That means investing in the research, development, and growth of the technologies of the future while using tools like tariffs in a steady, thoughtful, and targeted way to protect them as they grow.

priorities.heading: Medicare for All
priorities.quote: I will fight to expand Medicare to cover all necessary healthcare, including vision, dental, and hearing, and extend it to every single American from cradle to grave without premiums, copays, or deductibles.

cost-of-living.heading: Jobs and Trade
cost-of-living.quote: I believe in bringing dignified, well-paying jobs to Michigan. That means investing in the research, development, and growth of the technologies of the future while using tools like tariffs in a steady, thoughtful, and targeted way to protect them as they grow.

housing.heading: Housing and Homelessness
housing.quote: We need a building boom. And to create that we need to massively invest in building new housing in communities across the country, and to streamline local regulations that are making it way too hard to build anything in America.

health-care.heading: Medicare for All
health-care.quote: I will fight to expand Medicare to cover all necessary healthcare, including vision, dental, and hearing, and extend it to every single American from cradle to grave without premiums, copays, or deductibles.

immigration.heading: Immigration
immigration.quote: We must replace our broken and unpredictable immigration policy with a clear, comprehensive, and fair system. That begins with Abolishing ICE.

foreign-policy.heading: Sensible Foreign Policy
foreign-policy.quote: I oppose the illegal and unjustifiable war in Iran and demand an immediate end to the hostilities.

climate-energy.heading: Environment and Natural Resources
climate-energy.quote: That means codifying the Endangerment Finding into law, so no future administration can strip the EPA of its authority to regulate greenhouse gases by executive order.
